correctness.rationale: For every finite bounded integral commutative residuated chain, F1–F5 force f,g to round to their common fixed set S; F3 plus residuation proves S is closed under both residual and fusion. Conversely, subalgebra closure implies F3 and chain roundings imply F4–F5; F1–F2 are immediate. The least positive step with subtraction/negation gives exactly S_d for divisors d of n−1 and inclusion gives the divisor order. Standalone direct and independent subalgebra enumerators agree for four residuated-chain families.
